meta.name: user-skip-telemetry
meta.description: Counts Q&A skip events from the abort-safe-handler and qa-loop-ui outputs. Shows an optional skip-reason dropdown when a user-initiated skip occurred. Produces a structured skip_metrics_record suitable for PostHog ingestion. Used in Stage 4 of the /gaai:bootstrap pipeline after abort-safe-handler returns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统计用户跳过问答事件并生成数据记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在产品中追踪用户跳过问答的行为
copy.tagline_en: Count Q&A skip events and generate data records
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to track user skip behavior in your product

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会在问答循环结束后自动统计用户跳过的题目数量、类型和原因，并在用户主动跳过全部问题时弹出一个可选的原因选择框，最终生成一份可用于PostHog分析的跳过记录。
howto.when: 当用户在与Claude的问答交互中跳过问题（如输入“跳过”或选择“N”），并在abort-safe-handler返回后触发。每次bootstrap会话只执行一次。

say.note: 触发记录全部跳过，并询问原因
在原因下拉框中输入此选项，记录为time_pressed

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically count Q&A skip events, classify skip types (pre-loop, mid-loop skip-all, per-question, etc.), show an optional skip-reason dropdown when user-initiated skip occurs, and produce a structured skip_metrics_record for PostHog ingestion.
howto.when_en: Triggered immediately after abort-safe-handler returns, once per bootstrap session. It activates for all skip paths: pre-loop, mid-loop skip-all, per-question skips, and no-skip sessions.

say_en.note: triggers mid-loop skip-all and prompts for reason
input this in the reason dropdown to record as time_pressed
